name: Sri Venkateswara Steels ERP v2.8.9
notes: Official Release v2.8.9 for Sri Venkateswara Steels: - Live Stock Deductions & Low/Out of Stock Detection: Fixed delivery issue bill stock deductions to correctly calculate issued quantities and trigger Out of Stock (0 remaining) and Low Stock alerts. - Inward Supply Instant Single-Letter Search: Synchronous matching allows typing a single letter like 'N' to immediately display matching stock materials. - Duplicate Stock Row Prevention: Automatically unifies duplicate material rows and preserves user-selected units (KGS) and latest rates across inward entries and deletions.
